items.question: What is the Global Toothgems 3D Studio?
items.answer: An online creative space for composing tooth jewellery: you place pieces on a 3D dentition, move them around, change shapes and colours, and see the composition from every angle. The library holds the shop's own gems, in their colours and sizes.

items.question: How does the two-day trial work?
items.answer: While the Studio is in preview the editor is open to everyone free of charge, with no card: you can create and explore right now. Exactly how the trial will work once subscriptions exist is still to be defined.

items.question: What happens after the trial ends?
items.answer: What becomes of an account at the end of the trial — creations kept, moving to a plan, a reminder — has not been settled yet. This answer will be written before subscriptions open.

items.question: Which subscription should I choose?
items.answer: The three plans above differ by their monthly amount; what each one includes is still being defined. In the meantime, start with the trial: it is the best way to see what you need.

items.question: Can I change my subscription later?
items.answer: The rules for changing or ending a subscription will be set when subscriptions are built. No promise is made here until they are written down.

items.question: Do I need experience with 3D design to get started?
items.answer: No. You pick a piece, place it on a tooth and move it with the mouse, a finger or the keyboard; the view turns with a drag. A help page comes with the editor.
